name: Alineación Facial en Video
description: Analiza la alineación facial en video para detectar manipulación
algorithm: Face Alignment — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes facial alignment and landmark stability for video deepfake detection:

1. **Dense Facial Landmark Seguimiento**: A dense set of facial landmarks (68-468 points) is tracked per frame. Landmark positions are analyzed for both absolute accuracy (correct facial geometry) and temporal stability (smooth motion trajectories).

2. **Geométrico Consistencia Verificación**: Facial landmark geometry must conform to anthropometric constraints — inter-ocular distance vs. face width ratios, nose-mouth proportions, and facial thirds (forehead, nose, chin). The method checks whether geometric ratios remain consistent across frames and fall within normal human ranges. Deepfakes may produce faces with fluctuating proportions.

3. **Landmark Jitter Análisis**: In authentic video, facial landmarks follow smooth trajectories governed by musculoskeletal dynamics. The method measures high-frequency landmark position variations (jitter). Elevated jitter — particularly at face boundary landmarks — indicates deepfake artifacts from frame-independent face generation or imperfect face-to-background alignment.

4. **Pose - Corrected Alignment**: Landmarks are corrected for 3D head pose (yaw, pitch, roll) to evaluate face structure independent of viewing angle. After pose correction, facial proportions should remain constant. Deepfakes may produce pose-dependent proportion changes, indicating the generator doesn't maintain consistent 3D face geometry.

5. **Alignment Límite Análisis**: The alignment between generated face landmarks and background facial context (hairline, ears, neck) is checked. Misalignment at the face-swap boundary — where generated landmarks don't smoothly transition to background anatomy — indicates deepfake manipulation.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante face alignment analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
Yang, X. et al. (2019). Exposing Deep Fakes Using Inconsistent Head Poses. ICASSP.
